plan.title: Download Reports with No Fields Selected

steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ summary; this is the required first step for the prepared state.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the buyer inspects the bid and report controls.
Open the Download Reports window from the buyer's Responses view.
Assert that the Download Reports window opened.
Ensure Select all is unchecked before attempting the empty-selection download.
Attempt the report download with no fields selected, as required by the case.
Assert that the screen remains usable after the empty-selection download attempt.
